name: Adze
description: The Adze is a vampiric spirit of Ewe folklore (Ghana and Togo) that travels at night in the form of a firefly, drinking blood — especially from children — and causing illness; if caught, it transforms into human shape and is regarded as the spirit possessing a witch.
origin: The Ewe-speaking area of West Africa, comprising southeastern Ghana (Volta Region) and southern Togo, with related traditions among neighbouring Gbe-speaking peoples.
